app.name: Muga
app.tagline: Your internet radios, from any browser
radios.title: Speakers
radios.empty.title: No speakers yet
radios.empty.body: Connect a radio by its IP address. You'll find it in the radio's network settings menu.
connect.title: Connect a speaker
connect.host.label: IP address
connect.pin.label: PIN
connect.pin.hint: Usually 1234, unless you changed it on the radio
connect.error.unreachable: No radio answered at {host}. Check the address and that this device is on the same network.
connect.error.browser: Your browser didn't let Muga reach {host}: see above.
connect.error.notRadio: {host} answered, but it doesn't look like a compatible radio.
access.ask: Your browser will ask to let this site reach devices on your local network. Allow it, so Muga can talk to your radios.
access.blocked.title: This browser can't reach your radios from this page
access.blocked.body: Radios answer over plain HTTP, and this browser doesn't let a secure (https) page reach them. Use Chrome or Edge, on a computer or an Android phone. On an iPhone or iPad no browser allows it yet: open Muga there from a computer at home, over plain HTTP.
access.denied.title: Local network access is turned off for this site
access.denied.body: Muga needs it to talk to your radios. Allow “Local network access” in this site's settings (the icon at the left of the address bar), then reload the page.
power.label: Power
radio.forget.confirm: Forget {name}? You can connect it again later.
radio.offline.title: {name} isn't reachable
radio.offline.body: Make sure it's plugged in and on the same network. Muga keeps retrying.
radio.pin.title: Enter the PIN for {name}
radio.pin.body: The radio rejected the saved PIN.
radio.standby.title: {name} is in standby
radio.standby.body: Turn it on, or pick a source to start playing.
controls.label: Playback controls
volume.label: Volume
tuner.label: FM frequency
tabs.label: Sources, menu and presets
sources.empty: This radio didn't report any sources.
browse.standby: Turn the radio on to browse.
browse.unsupported: This source has no menu to browse.
browse.unavailable: There's nothing to browse on this source right now.
browse.search.label: Search this source
dab.hint: Look for DAB stations again, for example after moving the radio.
dab.confirm: Scan for DAB stations? The radio rebuilds its station list and removes stations it can no longer receive.
dab.scanning: Scanning for stations… {count, plural, =0 {none found yet} other {# found}}
dab.pruning: Removing stations that can't be received…
dab.done: Scan finished: {count, plural, =0 {no stations found} one {# station found} other {# stations found}}.
settings.title: Settings
settings.name.title: Name
settings.name.label: Speaker name
settings.name.tooLong: That name is too long for the radio.
settings.sleep.title: Sleep timer
settings.sleep.off: Off. Pick how long the radio should keep playing.
settings.sleep.active: Standby in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
settings.eq.title: Equalizer
settings.eq.customHint: Pick the first preset to adjust the sound yourself.
settings.quality.title: Streaming quality
settings.quality.hint: For internet radio and streaming services. Lower uses less data.
settings.clock.title: Clock
settings.language.title: Radio language
settings.language.label: Language of the radio's display and menus
settings.language.hint: This changes the radio, not Muga.
settings.device.title: About this speaker
presets.count: {count, plural, =0 {No presets} one {# preset} other {# presets}}
presets.empty: No presets stored for this source yet.
presets.standby: Turn the radio on to see its presets.
presets.editHint: Save what's playing into a slot, delete a preset or change the order.
presets.storeNothing: Nothing is playing that could be saved
groups.label: Multiroom group
groups.member.server: {name} leads {group}: the group plays what it plays.
groups.create.label: Group {name} with other speakers
groups.create.title: Group speakers
groups.create.hint: {name} leads the group: the others play what it plays, in sync.
groups.edit.title: Edit {name}
groups.name.label: Group name
groups.name.taken: Another group already has this name.
groups.name.renameHint: A new name means regrouping the speakers, so playback may stop for a moment.
groups.speakers.label: Speakers
groups.speakers.hint: Up to {max} speakers in a group.
groups.speakers.none: No other speakers with multiroom were found on your network.
groups.speaker.leadsFixed: Leads the group. To have another speaker lead, choose a source on that speaker's page.
groups.speaker.inGroup: Now in {group}; it moves to this group
groups.tooFew: With no other speakers, the group is ungrouped.
groups.source.title: {source} can't be shared with other speakers
groups.source.pick: Pick a source the group can play:
groups.source.confirm: {source} can't be shared with other speakers. Choosing it ends {group}. Continue?
groups.dissolve.confirm: Ungroup {name}? Each speaker goes back to playing on its own.
groups.standby.confirm: Put all of {group} in standby? Speakers in a group go to standby together.
groups.takeOver.title: Play something else
groups.takeOver.hint: Choosing a source here makes {name} lead {group}, and every speaker in the group plays it.
groups.takeOver.confirm: {name} will lead {group}, and every speaker in it will play {source}. Continue?
groups.unavailable: The speaker that leads {group} isn't one of your speakers yet. Connect it to control the group.
groups.volume.speaker: Volume of {name}
discover.title: On your network
discover.hint: Multiroom speakers your speakers know of.
discover.error.pin: {name} needs its PIN: connect it with the form below.
